english.title: Fail to comply with requirement not to consume / surrender alcohol

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: anti social behaviour crime and policing act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with a requirement, imposed on you by **(..SPECIFY NAME..),

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an authorised person,]_

(C)_[not to consume, in breach of a prohibition in a public spaces protection order, alcohol or anything which the constable reasonably believed to be alcohol]_
(D)_[not to consume, in breach of a prohibition in a public spaces protection order, alcohol or anything which the authorised person reasonably believed to be alcohol]_
(E)_[to surrender **(..SPECIFY DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTAINER..) in your possession which was, or which the constable reasonably believed to be, alcohol or a container for alcohol, where the constable reasonably believed that you had been consuming or intended to consume alcohol in circumstances in which doing so would be a breach of a prohibition in a public spaces protection order]_
(F)_[to surrender **(..SPECIFY DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTAINER..) in your possession which was, or which the authorised person reasonably believed to be, alcohol or a container for alcohol, where the authorised person reasonably believed that you had been consuming or intended to consume alcohol in circumstances in which doing so would be a breach of a prohibition in a public spaces protection order]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(6) and 68 of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
failed
without reasonable excuse
to comply with a requirement
imposed by a constable / authorised person
to not consume / surrender alcohol
consumption of which would breach prohibition in a public spaces protection order

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty Notice (under section 68 of the Act). Such a notice may be issued by a constable (and a suitably designated PCSO) as well as the local authority.
(ii) A fixed penalty issued for this offence is payable to the local authority and should not be processed using the PentiP system.
